svg.title: Parts, boundary-port directions and textual compartments
svg.desc: Original rendering example, not an official figure or validated model. Arrows and labels are caller-supplied; no direction is inferred. All four boundary placements are shown. Two selected compartments are shown below.

svg.title: Composite part usage
svg.desc: Minimal solid rounded part usage node with an editable name/type label. Represents the composite example. Prefix combinations, compartments and port attachments are not included.

svg.title: Boundary port with right arrow
svg.desc: Rounded boundary glyph containing the right direction indication. Glyph component only. Center it on a matching host boundary and supply the side-specific label. Arrow choice is caller-supplied; no feature-direction inference, nested-port layout, broken reference outline or proxy option.

svg.title: Part definition with parts compartment
svg.desc: A separated parts compartment with two editable literal rows and an elision marker. Fixed two-row layout, one selected compartment, no automatic parsing, wrapping or row generation. Names, prefixes and inherited/conjugated declarations remain the caller’s responsibility; this does not render every compartment-stack alternative.
